constellations.name: Orion
constellations.description: Orion is a prominent constellation recognizable by the three stars forming its belt.

constellations.name: Ursa Major
constellations.description: Ursa Major is a prominent northern constellation. Its seven brightest stars form the familiar Big Dipper pattern.

constellations.name: Cassiopeia
constellations.description: Cassiopeia is a northern constellation recognizable by its distinctive W-shaped pattern of bright stars.

constellations.name: Scorpius
constellations.description: Scorpius is a prominent constellation recognizable by its curved body and long tail.

constellations.name: Cygnus
constellations.description: Cygnus is a northern constellation whose bright stars form a distinctive cross-shaped pattern.
